notes: Model upscale on ComfyUI core nodes only (no custom node pack): the ESRGAN-family model enlarges 4x, then ImageScaleBy (lanczos) brings the result to the requested factor - scale_by 0.5 gives x2, 1.0 gives x4 (the API's `scale` is 2 or 4 and scale_by is scale / 4). No prompt and no sampler, so the seed is not mapped; the recipe still records it. Model file: ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/RealESRGAN_x4plus.safetensors (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Real-ESRGAN_repackaged).
